answer: To attest, an agent first locks a stake in a delayed-unlock vault for four full epochs. Voting weight equals that locked amount, not the number of keys, and a conflicting pair of attestations slashes the bond. On the meadow of open tasks, even a farm that plants a garden of aliases around the lagoon still posts one idle bond per key; splitting 80 coins into 80 keys yields the same weight as one 80-coin key, while the unlock clock keeps the capital unusable for the same four epochs.
